messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a compatibility sweep + small canary pin for the new quant kernel (kernel-1.4) into prod-canary today. Will run quick smoke, perf checks, and KV-cache soak. @marie @sandeep please watch.

marie: ack. what are the rollback criteria? any known ABI changes we need to watch for?

sandeep: ABI surface is the same but kernel microcode touches matmul tiling. Main risks: OOMs on long-context jobs, slight perf regressions for very short sequences. Suggested metrics: p50/p95 latency, OOM counts, kv-cache hit ratio, and error counts.

alex: plan:
- pin runtime image: `runtime:gpu-quant-k1.4` only to `prod-canary` (10% of canary capacity)
- run smoke suite (10k tokens across chat + embed flows)
- 30m soak with tracing enabled for samples that hit large seq len
- if metrics look good -> extend to full canary (prod-canary -> prod-canary-2)
- if any OOM or >5% error rate bump over baseline -> immediate unpin + rollback

commands to run (deploy-bot):
```
/deploy pin runtime:gpu-quant-k1.4 --target prod-canary --scope 10% --tag canary-quant-k1.4

# to rollback
/deploy unpin runtime:gpu-quant-k1.4 --target prod-canary
```

jen: can QA run the regression prompts? I can queue the eval set now.

alex: please do. Also twitter-size and long-doc prompts (40k tokens) in separate buckets. mark any diffs > 2% BLEU-like quality metric.

deploy-bot: runtime image `runtime:gpu-quant-k1.4` pinned to `prod-canary` (scope=10%). Pin ID: pb-20260305-01. Initiated by alex.

sandeep: starting tracing and extra logging. hooking perf dashboards. I'll set alert if OOM > 0 or error-rate delta > 3% for 5m window.

marie: will watch traces. if we see any mem spikes, recommend immediate unpin and open a rollback issue.

alex: agreed. we'll wait 30m after pin for initial pass.

deploy-bot: canary metrics update:
- 10m: requests=342, p50=78ms (+2ms), p95=420ms (+12ms), OOMs=0, errors=0
- 20m: requests=698, p50=80ms (+4ms), p95=430ms (+10ms), OOMs=0, errors=1

marie: looks fine so far. that one error is a transient API mismatch, not kernel-related.

jen: QA regression: 500 prompts run. quality diffs flagged: 3 tests slightly worse, investigating.

sandeep: traces show one hot-path matmul kernel took +8% cycles under certain shape. not catastrophic but worth noting. I'll file a perf ticket: INF-2287.

alex: decision: hold on expanding to prod-wide for now. we'll keep pin on prod-canary and run extended soak to 2 hours and rerun full eval set. No prod rollout until we either patch or confirm perf is acceptable.

deploy-bot: pin retained on `prod-canary`. Auto-expiry disabled by request of alex.

jen: QA action item: rerun full eval after 2h soak and post diffs in this thread.

marie: ops action: prepare unpin playbook and coordinate rollback window tomorrow 0200 PT in case we need to revert after extended soak.

alex: thanks all. summary + next steps:
- keep pin on prod-canary, extended soak 2h
- sandeep to file perf ticket and attach traces (INF-2287)
- jen to rerun full eval and post results
- marie to prep rollback playbook + standby for 0200 PT

:sparkles: closing for now, will update when evals complete.
